title: MCU Production Files
intro: [whispers] Welcome to Disney Jeopardy, and welcome behind the scenes. Tonight we raid the Marvel Studios filing cabinet: casting, crews, props and awards. [chuckles] Stay for the post-credits question.

art.prompt: A film soundstage at night with a director chair, a clapperboard, cables, a green screen and a silhouette of a camera crane, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Casting Calls
categories.intro: Let's go to the casting office. [chuckles] Name the actor, or the role.

art.prompt: An audition room with a single chair under a spotlight and a folding table covered in headshots, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: The director of Iron Man also plays Tony's driver, Happy Hogan.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Jon Favreau! Director, actor, and head of security.

clues.clue: Before Don Cheadle, this actor played James Rhodes in the first Iron Man.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Terrence Howard! [chuckles] Rhodey's first tour of duty.

clues.clue: Edward Norton played Bruce Banner in this 2008 film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Incredible Hulk! The MCU's second movie.

clues.clue: Carol Danvers' Kree mentor Yon-Rogg is played by this actor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jude Law! [dramatically] Charming, until he wasn't.

clues.clue: This actor voiced J.A.R.V.I.S. before playing Vision.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Paul Bettany! From voice in the walls to cape and forehead stone.

categories.title: Behind the Camera
categories.intro: Now the people who call action. [excited] Quiet on set!

art.prompt: A director viewfinder and headphones resting on a script on a film set crate, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This producer has led Marvel Studios as its president since 2007.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Kevin Feige! The man with the master plan and the baseball cap.

clues.clue: These sibling directors made Winter Soldier, Civil War, Infinity War and Endgame.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Russo brothers! [excited] Four of the biggest MCU chapters.

clues.clue: This director of Thor: Ragnarok also voices Korg.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Taika Waititi! He directs, and he's made of rocks.

clues.clue: Eternals was directed by this filmmaker, an Oscar winner for Nomadland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chloé Zhao! [warmly] Lots of real sunsets in that film.

clues.clue: This filmmaker directed The Marvels.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Nia DaCosta! Three heroes, one very busy director.

categories.title: Box Office & Awards
categories.intro: Our fan category: trophies and record books. [chuckles] Chet's acceptance speech is ready, just in case.

art.prompt: A row of shiny golden trophy statuettes on a velvet shelf under spotlights, no recognizable statues, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Black Panther became the first superhero film nominated for this top Oscar.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Best Picture! History-making, Wakanda style.

clues.clue: Black Panther took home this many Academy Awards.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is three! [excited] Costume design, production design and original score.

clues.clue: Avengers: Endgame's run as the highest-grossing film ever ended when an Avatar re-release passed it in this year.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is 2021! Blue aliens beat purple aliens.

clues.clue: This designer won Oscars for both Black Panther films' costumes, the first Black woman to win two Oscars.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Ruth E. Carter! Two films, two golden statues.

clues.clue: This composer won the Oscar for Black Panther's score.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ludwig Göransson! [excited] Talking drums and a full orchestra.

categories.title: Prop Room
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows a prop inspired by the MCU. Name it, or answer the question.

art.prompt: A warehouse of labeled prop crates, shelves of mysterious gadgets and a glowing case in the center, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This glowing device keeps Tony Stark's heart going. Name it. Pictured: a glowing circular blue-white device with copper coils set into a metal chest plate on a workbench.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the arc reactor! Proof that Tony Stark has a heart.

media.prompt: A glowing circular blue-white device with copper coils set into a metal chest plate on a workbench, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: These let Scott Lang shrink and grow. Name them. Pictured: a small glass laboratory vial filled with glowing red swirling particles on a steel lab table.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pym Particles! [laughs] Do not drink the vial.

media.prompt: A small glass laboratory vial filled with glowing red swirling particles on a steel lab table, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Drinking from this glowing plant grants the power of the Black Panther. Name it. Pictured: a glowing purple heart-shaped flower growing in a dark underground cave garden.
clues.reveal: [warmly] The correct answer is the Heart-Shaped Herb! Grown in vibranium-rich soil.

media.prompt: A glowing purple heart-shaped flower growing in a dark underground cave garden, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Steve Rogers kept a photo of this woman inside a compass like this one. Pictured: a vintage open brass pocket compass with a tiny faded black and white photo tucked inside the lid.
clues.reveal: [softly] The correct answer is Peggy Carter. He finally got that dance.

media.prompt: A vintage open brass pocket compass with a tiny faded black and white photo tucked inside the lid, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Sorcerers slip this onto their fingers to open spinning portals. Name it. Pictured: a golden double finger ring with an ornate loop.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a sling ring! [chuckles] Don't lose it in Antarctica.

media.prompt: A golden double finger ring with an ornate loop, a crackling circle of orange sparks forming in the air beside it, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Location Scouting
categories.intro: We scout filming locations from Georgia to the Himalayas. [excited] Passports out.

art.prompt: A location scout map table covered with photos of mountains, cities and deserts and a pair of binoculars, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Many MCU films have been shot at this Atlanta-area studio, formerly called Pinewood Atlanta.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Trilith Studios! Hollywood of the South.

clues.clue: Thor: Ragnarok and Thor: Love and Thunder were both filmed in this country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Australia! [chuckles] Asgard has very nice beaches.

clues.clue: Age of Ultron's Sokovia scenes were filmed partly in this Italian alpine region.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Aosta Valley! Lovely mountains, briefly airborne.

clues.clue: Civil War's German airport battle was largely filmed at the airport of this U.S. city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Atlanta! [laughs] Giant-Man did not have a boarding pass.

clues.clue: Doctor Strange's Kamar-Taj street scenes were filmed in this Nepalese city.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Kathmandu! Ancient streets, mystic arts.
